checks.name: no @/ import in a test file
checks.why: npm test runs test files under bare node, which does not resolve the @/ alias: import with a relative path and the .ts extension (see AGENTS.project.md, Imports in src/lib that tests reach).

checks.name: server function input is a zod schema
checks.why: A TypeScript type says what the editor sends, not what reaches the endpoint: put a zod schema in src/lib/security/inputs.ts and pass it to .validator().

checks.name: no enum
checks.why: Node's type stripping, which npm test uses, cannot run an enum: use a union of string literals, or an object with as const.

checks.name: parameter properties where a test may reach
checks.why: Node's type stripping, which npm test uses, cannot run parameter properties: if a test reaches this file, declare the field and assign it in the constructor's body.

checks.name: the editor stays out of the landing page (route)
checks.why: Unsplit, every page downloads the whole editor (about 1.7 MB): keep every route code-split (see AGENTS.project.md, The landing page must not download the editor).

checks.name: the editor stays out of the landing page (vite)
checks.why: A splitBehavior exception puts the editor back in every page's download (about 1.7 MB): keep every route code-split (see AGENTS.project.md, The landing page must not download the editor).
